description: Source code for the 'ir.module.record' model and a proxy class for recording object method calls and workflows in the OpenERP/Odoo framework.

classes.name: recording_objects_proxy
classes.description: Proxy class that wraps object method calls and workflows to record their usage when enabled.

classes.name: base_module_record
classes.description: Model class for recording and generating XML representations of module data and workflows.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Wraps object method execution to record query details if recording is active.

methods.name: exec_workflow
methods.description: Wraps workflow execution to record workflow calls if recording is active.

methods.name: _create_id
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for a new record based on its name and model.

methods.name: _get_id
methods.description: Retrieves the module and record ID for a given model and ID, creating a reference string.

methods.name: _create_record
methods.description: Creates an XML element representing a record with its fields and relations.

methods.name: get_copy_data
methods.description: Retrieves data from an existing record to facilitate copying.

methods.name: _create_function
methods.description: Creates an XML element representing a function (e.g., menu creation).

methods.name: _generate_object_xml
methods.description: Generates XML for create, write, menu_create, or copy operations.

methods.name: _generate_assert_xml
methods.description: Placeholder for generating assertion XML (not implemented).

methods.name: generate_xml
methods.description: Generates the complete XML document representing recorded data and workflows.
